KOTA KINABALU, 13 Oktober 2026 – Kerajaan Negeri Sabah mengarahkan semua sekolah di kawasan yang mencatatkan bacaan Indeks Pencemaran Udara (IPU) melebihi 150 selama tiga hari berturut-turut supaya ditutup sementara waktu.

Setiausaha Kerajaan Negeri Sabah, YB Datuk Zainudin bin Aman, yang juga Pengerusi Jawatankuasa Pengurusan Bencana Negeri, berkata langkah tersebut bertujuan melindungi murid dan guru daripada kesan buruk jerebu terhadap kesihatan.

Arahan itu turut selaras dengan arahan Kementerian Pendidikan susulan titah nasihat Yang di-Pertuan Agong, Sultan Ibrahim.

Setakat ini, semua sekolah di Tawau diarahkan ditutup mulai Rabu, 14 Oktober 2026, berikutan keadaan jerebu yang semakin buruk.

Orang ramai, khususnya ibu bapa dan penjaga, disaran mengikuti pengumuman rasmi pihak berkuasa dari semasa ke semasa bagi mendapatkan maklumat terkini berkaitan situasi jerebu dan operasi sekolah.

OPS GEGAR: JIM DETAINS 190 FOREIGNERS AT IBU KOTA ENTERTAINMENT CENTER

KUALA LUMPUR, October 17, 2026 – The Malaysian Immigration Department (JIM) through the Enforcement Division carried out Ops Gegar at an entertainment center around Kampung Pandan, Kuala Lumpur early this morning. The operation resulted in the detention of 190 foreign nationals suspected of committing various immigration offenses.

The operation, which started at 4.00 am, involved 107 officers of various ranks in collaboration with the National Registration Department (JPN), based on information obtained regarding the activities of foreign nationals at the premises.

Throughout the operation, 235 foreigners were inspected. Of this number, 190 individuals, comprising 99 Indonesian, Bangladesh, and Indian men and women aged between 20 and 41, were detained for suspected violations under the Immigration Act 1959/63 and Immigration Regulations 1963.
